resource.name: email-service
resource.description: Internal transactional email service used to send emails on behalf of consuming projects (e.g. notifications, confirmations, alerts).

config.description: Base URL of the internal email service, e.g. https://development-default.apps.94.72.97.95.sslip.io/internal-email-api

resource.consumptionInstructions: Whenever a project needs to send an email, call this service's API directly at its configured base URL. No authentication is required — the endpoint is reachable on the internal network with no API key or auth header.
